# Mikey's Mobile Detailing

> Owner-operated mobile car detailing serving Snohomish County and north King
> County, Washington. Mikey drives to the customer's home or workplace and
> details the vehicle in their driveway — there is no shop to visit. Rated
> 5.0 stars across 40 Google reviews, with 300+ cars detailed. Customers get an
> exact price from an on-site instant quote calculator in about 60 seconds, and
> pay only after they're satisfied with the work.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Mikey's Mobile Detailing
- **Type:** Mobile auto detailing service (the detailer travels to the customer)
- **Based in:** Snohomish, WA 98290
- **Phone:** (425) 600-7897
- **Email:** book@mikeysdetailing.com
- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM, seven days a week
- **Rating:** 5.0 out of 5 stars, 40 Google reviews
- **Experience:** 300+ vehicles detailed
- **Price range:** $160 – $379
- **Payment:** Payment is taken after the job — "you don't pay until you love it"
- **Requirements:** The customer provides access to an outdoor water spigot and a
  power outlet. The customer does not need to be home.

## Services and prices

- **Exterior Detail — $160 to $240.** Wash, decontamination, wheels, tires, glass,
  and protection applied to the paint.
- **Interior Detail — $200 to $280.** Vacuum, shampoo/extraction, plastics and
  leather cleaned and dressed, glass, deodorized. A basic interior takes about
  90 minutes.
- **Full Detail — $299 to $379.** Interior and exterior combined. Takes 3 to 5
  hours depending on vehicle size and condition.
- **Paint correction** — machine polishing to remove swirls and scratches.
- **Ceramic coating** — long-term paint protection, well suited to Pacific
  Northwest rain and road grime.
- **Pet hair removal** — specialist service for heavy pet-hair contamination.

## Cities served

Snohomish, Monroe, Lake Stevens, Everett, Mill Creek, Bothell, Marysville, and
Duvall, Washington — plus surrounding Snohomish County and north King County
communities.
